limitations.cpu_advised: Existing CPU advised is Lineitem-first and is not the GPU authored R; retained separately for transparency. Authored GPU Sequence has no corresponding CPU workload configuration.
limitations.join_filter: step_r + join_filter(r9) on Lineitem is rejected by existing Structures checker: scan has no admissible covering exact probe or semijoin. The R Lineitem is a built keyed RHS, not a covered probing scan. No different plan substituted.
limitations.gpu_lookup_physical: R+lookups additionally needs build_host_reads(); without it GPU catalog selection rejects r6: missing retained rows type.
limitations.gpu_structures: retain_lookups and join_filter are CPU-only; not attempted as CUDA witnesses.
limitations.process_status: Preserved R SF10 exceeds existing advised-mode 10.35ms performance ceiling; process exits 1 for that ceiling even though every full answer passes exactness. These are measured slow variants, not correctness failures.

reproduction.cpu: Generated default workload timing-worker (features/workloads/xtask/src/tpch/worker.rs) for retail_h05; DATA CONFIG 1 ANSWERS METRICS ORACLE, alternating five blocks. Counting worker uses RUNS=0 and features=counters. CQ_EXPANSION_COUNTERS=1 is set only for separate expansion-count builds.
reproduction.gpu_build: From experiments/gpu: CQ_GPU_TPCH_QUERIES=h05 CQ_GPU_TPCH_AUTOMATIC=1 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo oxide build --arch sm_89 -- --release -p cq-gpu-tpch; set TPCH_GPU_ADVICE to tpch/h05_step_r.json or tpch/h05_step_r_lookups.json for advised variants. Save each built executable before rebuilding.
reproduction.gpu_run: BINARY OUTPUT.json --query h05 --scale sf1|sf10 --mode automatic|advised; five blocks in alternating variant order, one warmup + five measured exact answers per process.
reproduction.counts: Same build with CQ_EXPANSION_COUNTERS=1; report stderr using tools/expansion_report.py. CPU temporary worker emits cq_storage::counters::render_expansions() after warm query drain.
